name: 3dxGC
description: Adaptive working-set governor for 3DXChat. Trims the game's resident footprint when it is backgrounded, minimised, or idle, or when its RAM use (or the PC's free RAM) crosses a set amount, and escalates to system-wide standby purges only under genuine memory pressure. Only the RAM-amount trigger may trim while the game holds focus, and it can be told not to. Leak watch reports memory no trim can return - exited processes a driver is still holding, apps and services that only grow - caps background apps' RAM (a hard ceiling Windows enforces, lifted when you switch to them, tightened to keep your chosen amount free), and asks before any restart: it never restarts an app, a service or Windows by itself.
author: 3DXModKit
